annotations.title: Change a modifier’s rules on a category

description: Change how a modifier is asked in ONE category — required, min, max, order — leaving every other category alone. Omit a field to leave it as it is; pass null to min or max to CLEAR that limit. The two are different, so be deliberate. The platform tidies the combination and reports what it actually stored: turning required on sets a minimum of 1, any minimum of 1 or more turns required on, and a "Pick one" modifier keeps no min or max at all. Read the result rather than assuming your input was kept. required: false together with a minimum of 1 or more is a contradiction and is refused.
